title: The Quebec Blackout — March 1989
description: A powerful CME caused a G5 geomagnetic storm that knocked out the Hydro‑Québec power grid for nine hours, leaving six million people without electricity.
historicalOutcome: The Hydro‑Québec power grid collapsed in 90 seconds. Six million customers lost power for nine hours. A large power transformer in New Jersey was permanently damaged.
